hits.draft_en:
Pieter reposted his server setup now that everyone is getting hacked: take your VPS off the public internet. Put it on a Tailscale network and serve the site through Cloudflare Tunnel. 262k views, 4.8k bookmarks, more bookmarks than likes.

His point: SSH key login doesn't protect you from the next exploit in your web stack. Fewer open ports means fewer doors.

His original setup: install Tailscale first, then lock the firewall so SSH only works over Tailscale and web traffic only comes from Cloudflare. Keep your provider's web console handy before you close ports, so you can't lock yourself out.

outsiders.name: Madison Mills
outsiders.text:
SCOOP: Major U.S. banks are detecting unauthorized third-party AI agents inside customer accounts, including some attempting to take actions that appear to be independent of user instructions, sources told Axios.

The findings have alarmed banking executives, who are racing to restrict access to their systems as AI moves at a velocity faster than financial institutions can respond, multiple industry and bank executives told Axios.

Several banks are now preparing for worst-case and even “day after” scenarios, including how to rapidly secure or restore customer accounts if things go wrong, the people said.

Several bank executives told Axios they're struggling to distinguish between human users and AI agents. One executive said banks also struggle to determine whether agents are authorized by customers or potentially operating without their permission, more akin to rogue agent behavior.

Read my latest for Axios here: https://t.co/Q3bda5In8q

virals.angle: Get your server off the public internet
virals.draft_en:
PHP on Tuesday. Ruby on Friday. Cloudflare's CEO expects more of these as AI finds old bugs.

If you run a VPS for a side project, Pieter's setup is the simplest fix:

1. Install Tailscale on the server and your laptop
2. SSH only over Tailscale
3. Serve the site through Cloudflare Tunnel
4. Firewall: close everything else

Both have free plans. Keep your host's web console open while you do it, so you can't lock yourself out.
virals.inspired_by: @levelsio VPS off the public internet (262k, 4.8k bookmarks) + 'both free, no excuses' (71k) + WireGuard alternative (40k) + @kimmonismus Cloudflare CEO warning (7.7k)
virals.video_tip: 12s: a server with red open ports, then four steps appearing one by one as ports go dark, caption one hour, fewer doors.

virals.angle: Patch week is every week now
virals.draft_en:
Tuesday it was PHP. Today it's Ruby: upgrade now if your app passes user input to the affected call.

This isn't a bad week. It's the new normal while AI makes old bugs cheap to find.

A small routine that holds up:
1. Write down every runtime and framework you run
2. Follow their security advisories
3. Turn on automatic OS updates
4. Block 30 minutes a week for patching

A vibe coded app is free like a kitten is free.
virals.inspired_by: @nateberkopec upgrade Ruby (51k) + @levelsio 'Today it's Ruby' (11k) + @swyx lock in on clearing bugs (34k) + @emollick AI helps attackers first (25k) + @dharmesh free like a kitten (17k)
virals.video_tip: 10s: a weekly calendar where a new language logo gets a patch stamp each day, ending on a 30 minute block, caption your weekly patch slot.

virals.angle: Keep agents away from your bank login
virals.draft_en:
Axios reports major US banks are finding unauthorized AI agents inside customer accounts, and they struggle to tell agents from people.

At the same time, agents are getting your passwords, and Claude sessions move to auto mode by default next week.

Before you connect an agent to anything with money:
1. Keep bank and brokerage logins out of its reach
2. Use read-only connections where you can

drafts.angle: Get your server off the public internet
drafts.draft_en:
PHP on Tuesday. Ruby on Friday. Cloudflare's CEO expects more of these as AI finds old bugs.

If you run a VPS for a side project, Pieter's setup is the simplest fix:

1. Install Tailscale on the server and your laptop
2. SSH only over Tailscale
3. Serve the site through Cloudflare Tunnel
4. Firewall: close everything else

Both have free plans. Keep your host's web console open while you do it, so you can't lock yourself out.

drafts.angle: Patch week is every week now
drafts.draft_en:
Tuesday it was PHP. Today it's Ruby: upgrade now if your app passes user input to the affected call.

This isn't a bad week. It's the new normal while AI makes old bugs cheap to find.

A small routine that holds up:
1. Write down every runtime and framework you run
2. Follow their security advisories
3. Turn on automatic OS updates
4. Block 30 minutes a week for patching

A vibe coded app is free like a kitten is free.

drafts.angle: Keep agents away from your bank login
drafts.draft_en:
Axios reports major US banks are finding unauthorized AI agents inside customer accounts, and they struggle to tell agents from people.

At the same time, agents are getting your passwords, and Claude sessions move to auto mode by default next week.

Before you connect an agent to anything with money:
1. Keep bank and brokerage logins out of its reach
2. Use read-only connections where you can
3. Check what auto mode will do without asking
4. Turn on transaction alerts
